title: 3996. Even Number of Knight Moves

examples.explanation: One possible sequence of moves is (1, 1) -> (3, 2) -> (2, 4) -> (4, 3) -> (2, 2). The knight reaches the target in 4 moves, which is even. Thus, the answer is true.
It is impossible to reach target = [6, 6] from start = [4, 5] in an even number of moves. Thus, the answer is false.
